RETAIL’S DIGITAL TEAMMATE

Built to work alongside store teams, our AI-powered, robotic teammate handles essential operational tasks with consistent precision—freeing associates to focus on customers and elevating every shopping experience.

Powering High-Performing Stores

Across the sales floor, our digital teammates leverage computer vision and artificial intelligence to accurately handle the work that keeps stores running at their best—so associates can be more focused on shoppers.

Inventory Management

  • Detects out-of-stocks and pricing discrepancies in real time

  • Prioritizes restocking based on product demand

  • Improves inventory visibility, product location, and promotion reporting across the store

Enhanced Communication

  • Communicates prioritized tasks via a mobile solution
  • Provides mobile Retail Media Network and advertising
  • Customer driven data and analytics capabilities

Safety & Security

  • Detects spills and safety hazards in real time to minimize risk

  • After-hours security procedures and checks to improve loss prevention

  • Food safety monitoring and waste minimization

Working Side by Side with Store Teams

By taking on time-consuming, repetitive tasks, our digital teammates free up store teams to focus on higher-value, people-first priorities:

  • Providing personalized assistance and resolving customer concerns
  • Helping shoppers find what they need, when they need it
  • Keeping checkout lines moving during busy hours
  • Driving improvements in store layout and operational flow

This human–technology partnership improves store productivity, strengthens customer relationships, and creates more satisfying shopping experiences.

What You Gain from a Digital Teammate

  • Extended Team: Consistent feedback to help prioritize tasks.

  • Reliability: Always on—no breaks, no distractions. Ready to perform every shift, without exception.

  • Focus: Zeroed in on critical operational tasks, without ever being pulled away by customer demands or changing priorities.

  • Adaptability: Seamlessly fits into your workflows and improves over time—getting smarter with every scan.

  • Consistency: Delivers dependable results across every store, every shift, every time.

  • Affordability: Solutions that fit comfortably within your store’s P&L—no upfront costs, no aging tech, just continuous innovation.

Data Analytics & Services

Better decisions start with better data. Every scan by our digital teammates generates insights that help you respond faster, optimize operations, and drive higher performance across all your stores.

  • Transforms scans into real-time alerts and restocking priorities
  • Identifies trends in pricing accuracy, product placement, and safety risks
  • Generates reports that help teams measure impact, optimize workflows, and plan ahead

With seamless integration into existing systems, these insights empower retailers to act with confidence—improving outcomes at both the store and enterprise level.
